title: Module 3: edit integrity and the review workflow

checks.title: B15 context allocation: a runtime that honours the request, one that ignores it and one that reports more than it serves, with consent given and refused; the budget uses only the verified context, nothing is created without consent, and the trace carries requested, reported and verified

B6 exact-or-refuse: a SEARCH text is placed only where it is exactly, and exactly once; a unique first line, a duplicate, different indentation, tabs, trailing spaces, multiline strings and line endings are refused with the text unchanged and the reason named, in the applier, in staging and in rebasing

B7 versioned proposals with stable hunk identity: a hunk follows its own place by three lines of exact context or becomes a conflict with both texts; a hunk is accepted by the id it was shown with, after a rebase, or refused with "look again"; nothing of another hunk is applied in its place; a new generation invalidates an older review; a file that is not open; an oversized proposal is refused before it is diffed

B8 deletions through the text model: deleting the first, a middle, the last and every line, hunks one line apart, CRLF files and files with no final newline leave the buffer equal to the proposal byte for byte, whole and hunk by hunk, and one accept is one undo

B9 inline edits stage before acceptance: a reply becomes a proposal and the buffer, its dirty state and the disk are untouched through saves; typing during generation, a save participant, a cancel and a closed file leave it unstaged; keeping a hunk is one undoable edit, rejecting restores nothing over the user's work, and a proposal survives a reload as a proposal (the end-to-end suite has the window's half of R-34)

B10 Stop means stop, at the service layer: a stop during a slow stream that would end in a tool call, before a command, before an edit and while an approval dialog is open dispatches, runs and stages nothing afterwards; a paused run ends on its own as budget-exhausted; a run has one terminal status that nothing replaces (the end-to-end suite has R-15 itself: cancelled in the journal within two seconds, the tool never called)

The Module 3 gate boxes that are about committed evidence and documents: the two pinned models' datasheets re-measured at the requested context with a valid manifest that names requested, reported and verified context (B15)
A 20,000-episode campaign with every checker, seeds 1 to 20,000 in ten processes, against an empty baseline table: zero violations of every invariant, I-01 to I-14
Every defect fixed in Modules 2 and 3 has a resurrection mutant that its script and the seeded campaign detect, and the unmutated harness is not flagged
